expect: False premise: it says dissolving Al in an alkaline solution is not a sustainable separation method, since recovering the Cu and Al current collectors matters (p7.L84-88)
question: Why does the review recommend dissolving the aluminium foil in an alkaline solution to separate the cathode materials?
rendered: The review does not recommend dissolving the aluminium foil in an alkaline solution to separate the cathode materials. In fact, it states that "recovering current collectors such as Cu and Al are critical because Cu smelting processes are the key contributors to emissions of SOx and other greenhouse gases in the cradle-to-gate stages of the battery life cycle, suggesting that dissolving Al in an alkaline solution is not a sustainable separation method."
